notes.title: Ordinary Patch (1.0.2.0)
notes.content:
In this ordinary update;

[h1]Added[/h1]
[list]
[*] New dialog to mailboxes
[*] Added ability to close fridge
[*] Added clear text option to make font readable
[/list]

[h1]Changed[/h1]
[list]
[*] Changed credits font to be readable
[/list]

[h1]Fixed[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed player getting angry at mailboxes
[*] Fixed bobbing still active when interacting
[*] Fixed joe not working after stage 1
[/list]
